page.overview:
What is Falona?

Falona is a fictional location in the Cthulhu Mythos. It was originally created by the late American author H. P. Lovecraft for his short story "The Doom That Came to Sarnath".

Falona is a region of the Dreamlands whose people are described as brave and adventurous, with yellow hair and blue eyes. When the city of Sarnath was destroyed, no one dared return to the site where it once stood until long after when adventurers from Falona made the distant journey there. They had expected to see what remained of the city, but all they found was the lake, the grey rock Akurion that reared high above the water, and the empty shore as if Sarnath had never existed. (: "The Doom That Came to Sarnath")

They also discovered, half buried in the marsh, the green stone idol of Bokrug, the Great Water Lizard. The idol was later enshrined at the high temple in the city of Ilarnek and subsequently worshipped throughout the land of Mnar. (: "The Doom That Came to Sarnath")
